Privacy Policy

Privacy by design.

Kimulisa is designed to be played offline, without creating an account or providing personal information. BAVUBUKA does not intend to collect, transmit, sell or share players' personal data through the game.

01. About this policy

This Privacy Policy applies to Kimulisa — Particle Storm ("Kimulisa", "the game"), developed and published by BAVUBUKA ("we", "us", "our"). It describes how the game handles information during normal gameplay and how to contact us about privacy.

02. Personal data collection

Kimulisa is designed not to request or collect names, email addresses, telephone numbers, precise locations, contacts, photographs, payment details, advertising identifiers, or other personal information. The game does not require registration or login.

The game is not designed to transmit gameplay analytics, crash reports or tracking data to BAVUBUKA. We do not operate a player account database or online player profiles for Kimulisa.

03. Information stored on your device

To support gameplay, Kimulisa may save limited game information locally on your device, such as your best score and game preferences or progress. This information is used only to provide the game experience and is not intended to be sent to BAVUBUKA or other parties.

Local game information is controlled by your device and operating system. Depending on your device settings, operating-system backup services may handle application data independently of BAVUBUKA.

04. Data sharing and third-party services

BAVUBUKA does not sell, rent or share personal data obtained through Kimulisa. The game is designed without advertising networks, third-party analytics, social sign-in or online leaderboards. It does not require an internet connection for gameplay.

If you download Kimulisa through an app store, that store may independently process information related to downloading, installing or updating the app under its own privacy policy. Such processing is separate from Kimulisa's gameplay.

05. Device permissions and network access

Kimulisa is designed to operate without requesting special device permissions, such as access to your camera, microphone, contacts or location. The game does not require network access for its core features.

Basic input and graphics capabilities supplied by your operating system are used to display the game and respond to touch or pointer gestures.

06. Security

Because Kimulisa is designed not to collect or transmit personal information, it does not maintain a remote repository of player data. Any locally stored game information remains subject to your device's application sandbox, operating-system security and backup settings. We recommend keeping your device software up to date.

07. Data retention and deletion

BAVUBUKA does not retain player accounts or personal gameplay records on its servers. Locally stored scores or preferences may remain on your device until they are cleared by your device's application-data controls or the app is uninstalled. Uninstalling may not remove copies retained by independent device backup services.

Because the game has no user accounts, there is no account deletion process. For questions about local data or privacy, contact us at the address below.

08. Age suitability

Kimulisa is intended for people aged 13 and above. The game is not designed to solicit personal information from children or adults. Its final age rating and target-audience declarations are determined through the applicable app-store review process.

09. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy if Kimulisa's features or privacy practices change, or to reflect applicable legal or platform requirements. Any updated version will be published on this page with a revised effective date. Material changes to data practices will be disclosed as required before they take effect.
